name: tensioner-mid
title: Tensioner: the middle shaft
description: The first stage's 34-tooth gear (left-handed) and the second stage's 17-tooth pinion (right-handed) on one hub.

module.rule: Stout teeth for a hand's torque: 5.4 lines across a tooth

helix.rule: Herringbone: no thrust, the gears stay on their shafts and centre themselves

bore.rule: On the frame's 6 mm pin, half a line clear, so it turns

teeth.rule: Two to one on the first stage

gap.rule: Between the stages: the first stage's gears and the second's clear each other
